G3400.def: of Latin origin; a thousand paces, i.e. a "mile":--mile.

G3401.def: middle voice from mimos (a "mimic"); to imitate:--follow.

G3403.et: a prolonged form of (3415) (from which some of the tenses are borrowed)
G3403.def: a prolonged form of «3415» (from which some of the tenses are borrowed); to remind, i.e. (middle voice) to recall to mind:--be mindful, remember.

G3404.def: from a primary misos (hatred); to detest (especially to persecute); by extension, to love less:--hate(-ful).

G3405.def: from «3406»; requital (good or bad):--recompence of reward.

G3408.def: apparently a primary word; pay for service (literally or figuratively), good or bad:--hire, reward, wages.

G3409.def: from «3408»; to let out for wages, i.e. (middle voice) to hire:--hire.

G3411.def: from «3409»; a wage-worker (good or bad):--hired servant, hireling.

G3412.def: for mutilene (abounding in shellfish); Mitylene (or Mytilene), a town on the island of Lesbos:--Mitylene.

G3413.def: of Hebrew origin («04317»); Michael, an archangel:--Michael.

G3414.def: of Latin origin; a mna (i.e. mina), a certain weight:-- pound.

G3415.et: middle voice of a derivative of (3306) or perhaps of the base of (3145) (through the idea of fixture in the mind or of mental grasp)
G3415.def: middle voice of a derivative of «3306» or perhaps of the base of «3145» (through the idea of fixture in the mind or of mental grasp); to bear in mind, i.e. recollect; by implication, to reward or punish:--be mindful, remember, come (have) in remembrance. Compare «3403».

G3416.def: of uncertain origin; Mnason, a Christian:--Mnason.

G3417.def: from «3415» or «3403»; recollection; by implication, recital:--mention, remembrance.

G3418.def: from «3415»; a memorial, i.e. sepulchral monument (burial-place):--grave, sepulchre, tomb.

G3419.def: from «3420»; a remembrance, i.e. cenotaph (place of interment):--grave, sepulchre, tomb.

G3421.def: from a derivative of «3420»; to exercise memory, i.e. recollect; by implication, to punish; also to rehearse:--make mention; be mindful, remember.

G3423.def: from a derivative of «3415»; to give a souvenir (engagement present), i.e. betroth:--espouse.

G3424.def: from «3425» and «2980»; hardly talking, i.e. dumb (tongue-tied):--having an impediment in his speech.

G3425.def: adverb from a primary mogos (toil); with difficulty:--hardly.

G3426.def: of Latin origin; a modius, i.e. certain measure for things dry (the quantity or the utensil):--bushel.

G3427.def: the simpler form of «1698»; to me:--I, me, mine, my.

G3428.et: a prolonged form of the feminine of (3432)
G3428.def: a prolonged form of the feminine of «3432»; an adulteress (literally or figuratively):--adulteress(-ous, -y).

G3429.def: from «3432»; (middle voice) to commit adultery:--commit adultery.

G3432.def: perhaps a primary word; a (male) paramour; figuratively, apostate:--adulterer.

G3433.def: probably by variation for «3425»; with difficulty:--hardly, scarce(-ly), + with much work.

G3434.def: of Hebrew origin («04432»); Moloch (i.e. Molek), an idol:--Moloch.

G3437.def: from «3201»; blame, i.e. (by implication), a fault:--quarrel.

G3438.def: from «3306»; a staying, i.e. residence (the act or the place):--abode, mansion.

G3439.def: from «3441» and «1096»; only-born, i.e. sole:--only (begotten, child).

G3440.def: neuter of «3441» as adverb; merely:--alone, but, only.

G3441.def: probably from «3306»; remaining, i.e. sole or single; by implication, mere:--alone, only, by themselves.

G3443.def: from «3441»; to isolate, i.e. bereave:--be desolate.

G3444.et: perhaps from the base of (3313) (through the idea of adjustment of parts)
G3444.def: perhaps from the base of «3313» (through the idea of adjustment of parts); shape; figuratively, nature:--form.

G3445.def: from the same as «3444»; to fashion (figuratively):--form.

G3446.def: from «3445»; formation, i.e. (by implication), appearance (semblance or (concretely) formula):--form.

G3447.def: from «3448» and «4160»; to fabricate the image of a bullock:--make a calf.

G3448.def: probably strengthened for oschos (a shoot); a young bullock:--calf.

G3449.def: from the base of «3425»; toil, i.e. (by implication) sadness:--painfulness, travail.

G3450.def: the simpler form of «1700»; of me:--I, me, mine (own), my.

G3451.pos:
1. devoted to and skilled in the arts sacred to the muses
  2. accomplished in the liberal arts
  3. specifically, skilled in music
  4. playing on musical instruments
G3451.def: from Mousa (a Muse); "musical", i.e. (as noun) a minstrel:--musician.

G3452.def: perhaps a primary word; the marrow:--marrow.

G3453.def: from the base of «3466»; to initiate, i.e. (by implication) to teach:--instruct.

G3454.et: perhaps from the same as (3453) (through the idea of tuition)
G3454.def: perhaps from the same as «3453» (through the idea of tuition); a tale, i.e. fiction ("myth"):--fable.

G3455.et: from a presumed derivative of muzo ( to "moo")
G3455.def: from a presumed derivative of muzo ( to "moo"); to bellow (roar):--roar.

G3456.et: from a derivative of the base of (3455) (meaning snout, as that whence lowing proceeds)
G3456.def: from a derivative of the base of «3455» (meaning snout, as that whence lowing proceeds); to make mouths at, i.e. ridicule:--mock.

G3458.et: probably ultimately from the base of (3433) (through the idea of hardship)
G3458.def: probably ultimately from the base of «3433» (through the idea of hardship); a "mill", i.e. (by implication), a grinder (millstone):--millstone.

G3460.def: of uncertain derivation; Myra, a place in Asia Minor:--Myra.

G3461.def: from «3463»; a ten-thousand; by extension, a "myriad" or indefinite number:--ten thousand.

G3463.et: plural of an apparently primary word (properly, meaning very many)
G3463.def: plural of an apparently primary word (properly, meaning very many); ten thousand; by extension, innumerably many:--ten thousand.

G3464.def: probably of foreign origin (compare «04753», 4666); "myrrh", i.e. (by implication) perfumed oil:--ointment.

G3465.def: of uncertain origin; Mysia, a region of Asia Minor:--Mysia.

G3466.et: from a derivative of muo (to shut the mouth)
G3466.def: from a derivative of muo (to shut the mouth); a secret or "mystery" (through the idea of silence imposed by initiation into religious rites):--mystery.

G3467.et: from a compound of the base of (3466) and ops (the face, from (3700))
G3467.def: from a compound of the base of «3466» and ops (the face; from «3700»); to shut the eyes, i.e. blink (see indistinctly):-- cannot see far off.

G3468.et: from molos ("moil", probably akin to the base of (3433)) and probably ops (the face, from (3700))
G3468.def: from molos ("moil"; probably akin to the base of «3433») and probably ops (the face; from «3700»); a mole ("black eye") or blow-mark:--stripe.

G3469.def: from «3470»; to carp at, i.e. censure (discredit):--blame.

G3470.def: perhaps from «3201»; a flaw or blot, i.e. (figuratively) disgraceful person:--blemish.

G3471.def: from «3474»; to become insipid; figuratively, to make (passively, act) as a simpleton:--become fool, make foolish, lose savour.

G3473.def: from a compound of «3474» and «3004»; silly talk, i.e. buffoonery:--foolish talking.

G3474.def: probably from the base of «3466»; dull or stupid (as if shut up), i.e. heedless, (morally) blockhead, (apparently) absurd:--fool(-ish, × -ishness).

G3475.def: of Hebrew origin; («04872»); Moseus, Moses, or Mouses (i.e. Mosheh), the Hebrew lawgiver:--Moses.

G3476.def: of Hebrew origin («05177»); Naasson (i.e. Nachshon), an Israelite:--Naasson.

G3477.def: probably of Hebrew origin (compare «05052»); Nangae (i.e. perhaps Nogach), an Israelite:--Nagge.

G3478.def: or Nazaret nad-zar-et'; of uncertain derivation; Nazareth or Nazaret, a place in Palestine:--Nazareth.

G3479.def: from «3478»; a Nazarene, i.e. inhabitant of Nazareth:--of Nazareth.

G3480.def: from «3478»; a Nazoraean, i.e. inhabitant of Nazareth; by extension, a Christian:--Nazarene, of Nazareth.

G3481.def: of Hebrew origin («05416»); Nathan, an Israelite:--Nathan.

G3482.def: of Hebrew origin («05417»); Nathanael (i.e. Nathanel), an Israelite and Christian:--Nathanael.

G3483.pos: 1. yea, verily, truly, assuredly, even so
G3483.et: a primary particle of strong affirmation
G3483.def: a primary particle of strong affirmation; yes:--even so, surely, truth, verily, yea, yes.

G3484.def: probably of Hebrew origin (compare «04999»); Nain, a place in Palestine:--Nain.

G3485.def: from a primary naio (to dwell); a fane, shrine, temple :--shrine, temple. Compare «2411».

G3486.def: of Hebrew origin («05151»); Naum (i.e. Nachum), an Israelite:--Naum.

G3488.et: a flower of the same name, from narke (stupefaction, as a "narcotic")
G3488.def: a flower of the same name, from narke (stupefaction, as a "narcotic"); Narcissus, a Roman:--Narcissus.

G3489.def: from a compound of «3491» and «71»; to be shipwrecked (stranded, "navigate"), literally or figuratively:--make (suffer) shipwreck.

G3490.def: from «3491» and «2819» ("clerk"); a captain:--owner of a ship.

G3491.def: from nao or neo (to float); a boat (of any size):--ship.

G3492.def: from «3491»; a boatman, i.e. seaman:--sailor, shipman.

G3493.def: of Hebrew origin («05152»); Nachor, the grandfather of Abraham:--Nachor.

G3494.def: from a derivative of «3501»; a youth (up to about forty years):--young man.

G3495.def: from the same as «3494»; a youth (under forty):--young man.

G3496.def: from «3501» and «4172»; new town; Neapolis, a place in Macedonia:--Neapolis.

G3497.def: of Hebrew origin («05283»); Neeman (i.e. Naaman), a Syrian:--Naaman.

G3498.et: from an apparently primary nekus (a corpse)
G3498.def: from an apparently primary nekus (a corpse); dead (literally or figuratively; also as noun):--dead.

G3499.def: from «3498»; to deaden, i.e. (figuratively) to subdue:--be dead, mortify.
